question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the highlighted group of words in the given sentence.

The minister went to visit the **__monuments set up for people who were buried in other countries__.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cenotaphs"** refers to monuments set up to honor people whose remains are buried elsewhere. (यादगार स्मारक)

 
 
• **Example: **The Cenotaph in London is a well-known war memorial dedicated to the soldiers who died in World War I and whose bodies were never recovered.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Graves** (कब्रें): Places where dead bodies are buried.

 
 
• **Example:** The cemetery is filled with graves of soldiers who fought in the war.
 
 
 
• **Cemetery** (कब्रिस्तान): A large burial ground, especially one not in a churchyard.
 
 
• **Example: **They visited the cemetery to pay their respects to their ancestors.
 
 
 
• **Coffins** (ताबूत): Boxes in which dead bodies are placed for burial.
 
 
• **Example:** The coffin was draped with the national flag during the funeral ceremony.
